events.name: Neal Francis
The Rick Burgess Show Presents the "Are You Ready Live Tour"

presales.name: Buy One, Get One Promo
presales.description: Buy one get one free on all standard admission tickets!

events.info: The Are You Ready Tour is not just another show; it is a live celebration of everything you love about The Rick Burgess Show. The Are You Ready Tour brings The Rick Burgess Show live to the stage for an interactive, high energy experience you wont hear on the radio. From stand up comedy and live audience interaction to contests, prizes, and a no holds barred Q&A, every stop on the tour is packed with surprises. And if you think you know the music, think again! Get ready to rock with Mr. Lucky, famously known among fans as the Worlds Greatest Garage Band. This legendary Alabama group, formed by Rick and longtime friends back in the 90s, helped define the shows signature sound and earned that fan given title with performances and memories that still get talked about today. For the first time since 2003, Mr. Lucky is back on stage, making this a truly once in a generation moment for longtime listeners.

venues.name: The Lyric Theatre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Lyric Theatre does not have a full-time box office. The on-site box office opens 1 hour before showtime for most events. Advance tickets may be purchased at Ticketmaster.com.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available beginning 1 hour before that show. Will Call tickets may not be picked up at another event or when the box office is not open.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Floor level (1st level) is accessible and does not require any stairs for access. Wheelchair spaces are marked on the Floor level. Seating in the Loge, Opera Boxes, and Balcony requires stairs for access. There is not an elevator in the Lyric Theatre. By purchasing seats in these sections you agree that you will take stairs to that area. The Lyric Theatre cannot guarantee that you can be seated in another section if you are unable to use stairs.

generalInfo.generalRule: Tickets sold as General Admission do not have assigned seats and are first come, first served. Your ticket may say General Admission, GENADM, or GA to signify General Admission. A number on a General Admission Ticket is not a seat number. Wheelchair accessible seating is not assigned for General Admission vents and is first come, first served. No weapons of any kind are allowed in the Lyric Theatre. All guests will be scanned with a metal detector wand and bags will be checked before entry to the building. No outside food or drink is allowed.
generalInfo.childRule: Children ages 2 and under do not need a ticket for most shows. This policy may vary for events designed for children. Please check the event listing for more specific information.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office opens at 3PM on show days only
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All points of sale will only accept credit or debit via card or mobile pay. This is a cashless venue
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Do not forget to bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order. If you need to change the name on your tickets, you will need to reach out to Ticketmaster Customer Service at 800.653.8000. Unfortunately, guests are not able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If you are meeting up with friends, we recommend arranging a time and place to hand off tickets directly. If tickets or passes are being left for you including Meet and Greet passes, backstage passes, press or media passes, or tickets from the tour or a promotional company, they will only be available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan to pick them up then and not earlier. If your tickets or passes are not available yet, please reach out directly to the person who left them for you, as the box office is unable to contact tour staff on behalf of guests.

venues.parkingDetail: Fans will have access to several secure, staffed, and lighted parking options as well as a dedicated rideshare location. Fans can also hop on the brand-new Tram line that connects Uptown Entertainment District to the amphitheater. Pre-paid parking options are now available for a smooth arrival! For more information about parking, visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes! Please visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/accessibility for information on all venue accessibility.

generalInfo.generalRule: For general information for the venue visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/know-before-you-go.
generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages, unless otherwise noted on a show. Children 2 and under do not require a ticket, but must sit on a caregiver lap if they are located in the seats.

venues.name: Protective Stadium

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The BJCC Central Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday 9:00am to 4:00pm CT. The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. The Protective Stadium Box Offices located at the South Gate and Northeast Gate are only open the day of the event. Hours vary based on the event. To inquire about the hours for a specific event, please contact cto@bjcc.org.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available the day of the event at the Protective Stadium Box Office located at the South Gate. Hours vary based on the event. To inquire about the hours for a specific event, please contact cto@bjcc.org. When using Will Call, please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit https://protectivestadium.com/directions-and-parking/ for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to laser pointers, weapons, glass containers, cans, chains, outside food or beverage, professional recording devices for photography, video or audio, stools or folder chairs. See a full list of prohibited items at https://protectivestadium.com/bag-policy-and-prohibited-items/ Bags must be CLEAR plastic, vinyl or PVC and not exceed 12"x6"x12". Bags cannot be tinted with color or include oversized content that prevents visibility into the clear bag. Only non-clear bags smaller than 5"x7" will be permitted entry. The venue reserves the right to search all guests entering the arena and to refuse entry at the discretion of management. Smoking is prohibited inside Protective Stadium and only allowed in designated smoking areas outside of the building.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children who have celebrated their 2nd birthday are required to have a ticket. For show specific age restrictions that may supersede our standard policy, visit www.bjcc.org/events
